description: This file defines a simple dependency injector object for an Android application, providing singleton instances of app components such as the repository, database, shared preferences, and various use case objects. It avoids using Hilt for dependency injection and instead manually constructs dependencies.

classes.name: Injector
classes.description: A singleton object that provides app-wide dependencies such as repository and use case instances, constructed manually.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of AppRepository, initializing it if necessary with dependencies like database, shared preferences, and scheduler.

methods.name: buildRepository
methods.description: Creates and configures a new AppRepository instance, setting up Room database, encrypted shared preferences, and other dependencies.

methods.name: getInstalledApps
methods.description: Provides an instance of GetInstalledAppsUseCase with the current repository.

methods.name: toggleHide
methods.description: Provides an instance of ToggleHideAppUseCase with the current repository.

methods.name: toggleLock
methods.description: Provides an instance of ToggleLockAppUseCase with the current repository.

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Provides an instance of SetPinUseCase with the current repository.

methods.name: validatePin
methods.description: Provides an instance of ValidatePinUseCase with the current repository.

methods.name: scheduleRule
methods.description: Provides an instance of ScheduleLockRuleUseCase with the current repository.
